title: Classic Wooden Building Blocks Set
description:
Beautiful set of 100 natural wooden building blocks in various shapes and sizes. Perfect for developing motor skills and creativity. All blocks are smooth, non-toxic, and safe for children.

Includes:
- 100 wooden blocks in different shapes
- Sturdy storage bag
- Idea booklet with building patterns

The blocks have been gently used by one child and are in excellent condition. All pieces are included and have been thoroughly cleaned.
